name: Branch of Fruiting Grapes
dimensions:
painting proper: 123.2 x 36.4 cm (48 1/2 x 14 5/16 in.)
mounting, including cord and bottom roller: 241.6 x 54 cm (95 1/8 x 21 1/4 in.)
summary: In vertical format and painted in ink on paper, this hanging scroll depicts a fruiting grapevine. Two intertwined vines enter the composition from the top center; laden with lush, broad leaves and with heavy, ripe fruit, the vines hang downward, descending toward the bottom of the paper support, at which point one vine curves slightly upward and to the right, reaching almost to the painting’s right edge.
